notes.title: Major October Update
notes.content: Welcome everyone to the OCTOBER UPDATE for Usagi Health Club! This major update contains major bug fixes, grammatical error fixed and and an added feature where you can now browse through the CG variants instead of just only able to see the first CG while unlocked.

notes.title: Day 1 Update
notes.content: Correctly displays the artist's name who developed all the artwork for this game. Includes some minor bug-fixes.
